Data policy: no fabricated proxies. Official public sources provide the primary foundation for United States; native statistical and central bank releases are prioritized where available. 数据原则：不制造 proxy。官方公开来源提供美国的基础数据；优先接入本国统计局与央行的原生发布序列。

Data Quirks & Release Discipline数据特性与发布纪律

The GS guide opens with revisions, seasonal adjustment, and sequential-versus-year-over-year reporting. The dashboard keeps this as a standing caveat for all high-frequency US releases.GS指南开篇强调修订、季调以及环比/同比口径差异。该页面把这些作为所有美国高频数据的基础提示。
Official chart series for this section are currently in development.本分析模块的官方指标序列正在标准化接入中。

Market Impact & GS Proprietary Indexes市场影响与GS专有指数

The report highlights market-moving releases and GS proprietary gauges such as GSFCI, GSAI, and GSSI. Public component series are charted where possible; proprietary aggregates are tracked as gaps.报告强调市场敏感数据以及GSFCI、GSAI、GSSI等GS专有指标。公开组成项尽量绘图；专有综合指标列入缺口。
Official chart series for this section are currently in development.本分析模块的官方指标序列正在标准化接入中。
